zh.principle: **算法**：离散对数问题（Discrete Logarithm Problem）。SP 800-186 在椭圆曲线群内、以加法记号定义该问题：对由 P 生成的循环子群中的点 R，满足 R = kP 的唯一整数 k，在 sp800-186.txt:438-439 处是 「This number is called the discrete logarithm of R to the base P.」（这个数称为 R 以 P 为底的离散对数）；任务在 439-440 处给出：「The discrete logarithm problem is the problem of finding the discrete logarithm of R to the base P for any two points P and R on the curve, if such a number exists.」（离散对数问题即：给定曲线上两点 P 与 R，求 R 以 P 为底的离散对数（若该数存在））。说明 R 属于该子群的属于记号（第 437 行）在本抽取中退化，故群的设定作转述，两句定义则整段引用（正文左对齐、以单空格接合）。加法记号是椭圆曲线情形的写法；在有限域上同一问题以乘幂形式表述，这一点由其他被引文件指明。
zh.why: 为何把离散对数当作承重的假设：那些被充分研究过的曲线形式，其选取恰恰要保证换一种表示并不削弱它。RFC 8032 就 Ed25519 曲线说明，它相对 Curve25519 的坐标变换意味着「discrete logarithm problem is the same as for Curve25519.」（离散对数问题与 Curve25519 相同）；就 Ed448 形式相对 Ed448-Goldilocks，则换基点是「which preserves difficulty of the discrete logarithm.」（保持离散对数的难度）。两段引文都取自单行原文（它们从句中起，因为句子会换行）。由此给出的设计理由是可迁移性：等价的曲线保持同样的难问题，于是对某一群上离散对数假设的信心可传到实际使用的那个群。RFC 8032 此处并不量化该难度，故该条目不声称具体的比特级强度数字。
zh.used: 离散对数问题是 NIST 密钥建立标准所依据的假设。NIST IR 8547 在 nist-ir8547-final.txt:347-348 印着 「SP 800-56A specifies key-establishment schemes based on the discrete logarithm problem over finite fields and elliptic curves, including several variations of Diffie-Hellman」（SP 800-56A 规定了基于离散对数问题的密钥建立方案——涵盖有限域与椭圆曲线上的多种 Diffie-Hellman 变体）。这段引用有意到此为止：紧随其后的 Menezes-Qu-Vanstone 名字跨连字符换行，而校验器在归一化时会把该断行无连字符地接合，所以本句只引用到干净印出的 "Diffie-Hellman"。它支持的声明很窄且标准：Diffie-Hellman 密钥建立这一族（有限域与椭圆曲线皆有）建立在离散对数问题之上。文档在 DH/MQV 族之外规定的内容不在此复述。
zh.broken: FIPS 203 既点明依赖也点明失效。它的背景段（fips203.txt:358）印着大规模量子计算机会使 「This would include key-establishment schemes and digital signature schemes whose security depends on the difficulty of solving the integer factorization and discrete logarithm problems (both over finite fields and elliptic curves).」（这会包括那些安全性取决于求解整数分解与离散对数问题之难度的密钥建立与数字签名方案——有限域与椭圆曲线皆是）；又在 fips203.txt:354 印着 「The key establishment schemes specified in SP 800-56A and SP 800-56B are vulnerable to attacks that use sufficiently-capable quantum computers.」（SP 800-56A 与 SP 800-56B 规定的密钥建立方案，易受使用足够强大量子计算机的攻击）。就这一份文件而言，离散对数假设正是会崩塌之处：依赖离散对数问题难度的方案，按文本所说易受足够强大的量子计算机攻击。注意措辞范围：FIPS 203 把失效归因于量子计算机，却未点名具体算法，所以该条目只沿用原文的 quantum computers 一词，不从别的文件搬来某个攻击的名称。
zh.history: 这些留存来源印出的可定年历史，讲的是针对该假设弱点的应对，而非问题本身之起源。FIPS 203 在 fips203.txt:358 记录 「in 2016, NIST initiated a public Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Standardization process to select quantum-resistant public-key cryptographic algorithms.」（2016 年，NIST 启动公开的抗量子密码标准化进程，遴选抗量子的公钥算法）——给出了一个具体年份，对应于取代离散对数类方案的标准化。该文件本身的日期在 fips203.txt:13，“Published August 13, 2024”，所以该条目是一份 2024 年的文献在叙述 2016 年的进程。至于离散对数问题最初由谁、在何年提出，本行这四份留存文件都没有给出，故该条目不点名发明者、不写创始年代；只记录来源确实印出的内容，该问题更早的历史属于本目录的其他行。

en.principle: **Algorithm**: Discrete Logarithm Problem (离散对数问题). SP 800-186 defines the problem inside an elliptic-curve group, written additively: for a point R in the cyclic subgroup generated by P, the unique integer k with R = kP is, at sp800-186.txt:438-439, "This number is called the discrete logarithm of R to the base P.", and the task is set at 439-440 as "The discrete logarithm problem is the problem of finding the discrete logarithm of R to the base P for any two points P and R on the curve, if such a number exists.". The membership glyph stating that R lies in the subgroup (line 437) degrades in this extraction, so the group setup is paraphrased while the two definition sentences are quoted intact (the body is left-aligned and rejoins with single spaces). The additive notation here is specific to the elliptic-curve case; over finite fields the same problem is posed with exponentiation, which the other cited documents name.
en.why: Why the discrete logarithm is treated as the load-bearing assumption: well-studied curve forms are chosen precisely so that switching representation does not weaken it. RFC 8032 states, of the Ed25519 curve, that its change of coordinates relative to Curve25519 means the "discrete logarithm problem is the same as for Curve25519.", and, of the Ed448 form relative to Ed448-Goldilocks, that the change of basepoint "which preserves difficulty of the discrete logarithm.". Both fragments are quoted from single raw lines (they start mid-sentence because the sentence wraps). The design reason this gives is transferability: an equivalent curve keeps the same hard problem, so confidence in the discrete-logarithm assumption on one group carries to the group actually used. RFC 8032 does not quantify that difficulty here, so no concrete bit-level hardness figure is claimed in this entry.
en.used: The discrete logarithm problem is the assumption under NIST's key-establishment standards. NIST IR 8547 prints, at nist-ir8547-final.txt:347-348, "SP 800-56A specifies key-establishment schemes based on the discrete logarithm problem over finite fields and elliptic curves, including several variations of Diffie-Hellman". The marked run deliberately stops there: the very next name, Menezes-Qu-Vanstone, wraps across a hyphen line-break, and the precheck normaliser rejoins that break without the hyphen, so the sentence is quoted only up to the cleanly-printed "Diffie-Hellman". The claim this supports is narrow and standard: the Diffie-Hellman key-establishment family (over both finite fields and elliptic curves) rests on the discrete logarithm problem. What the document specifies beyond the DH/MQV family is not restated here.
en.broken: FIPS 203 names both the dependence and the break. Its context paragraph prints (fips203.txt:358) that a large-scale quantum computer would put at risk "This would include key-establishment schemes and digital signature schemes whose security depends on the difficulty of solving the integer factorization and discrete logarithm problems (both over finite fields and elliptic curves).", and (fips203.txt:354) that "The key establishment schemes specified in SP 800-56A and SP 800-56B are vulnerable to attacks that use sufficiently-capable quantum computers." Together, from this one document, the discrete-logarithm assumption is exactly the thing that collapses: schemes resting on the difficulty of the discrete logarithm problem are, per the text, vulnerable to sufficiently capable quantum computers. Note the scope of the wording: FIPS 203 attributes the break to quantum computers but does not itself name the algorithm, so this entry says quantum computers in the document's own words and does not import the name of a specific attack from another file.
en.history: The dated history these retained sources print is about the response to the assumption's weakness, not about its origin. FIPS 203 records, at fips203.txt:358, "in 2016, NIST initiated a public Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Standardization process to select quantum-resistant public-key cryptographic algorithms." - a concrete year attached to the standardization that replaced the discrete-log-based schemes. The publication itself is dated fips203.txt:13, "Published August 13, 2024", which is why the entry reports a 2024 document describing a 2016 process. The discrete logarithm problem's own first statement, proposer or decade is not given in any of the four retained files for this row, so this entry names no inventor and no founding date; it records only what the sources actually print, and any earlier history of the problem belongs to other rows in this catalogue.

zh: 离散对数：由 R = kP 中反求标量 k 的整数，即 R 以 P 为底的离散对数（sp800-186:438-440）。
离散对数问题（DLP）：在群中由底元与目标元求离散对数的计算难题（sp800-186:439-440）。
有限域与椭圆曲线：DLP 的两种设定，以乘幂或标量乘表述（ir8547:347、fips203:358）。
难度保持：等价曲线经坐标或基点变换保持同一离散对数难度（rfc8032:521、:834）。
量子失效：依赖 DLP 难度的方案易受足够强大的量子计算机攻击（fips203:354、:358）。
抗量子标准化：2016 年 NIST 启动 PQC 进程以替代离散对数类方案（fips203:358）。
en: discrete logarithm: the integer k recovering R = kP, the discrete log of R to the base P (sp800-186:438-440).
discrete logarithm problem (DLP): computing that logarithm from base and target in a group (sp800-186:439-440).
finite field and elliptic curve: the two settings of DLP, by exponentiation or scalar multiplication (ir8547:347, fips203:358).
difficulty preservation: equivalent curves keep the same discrete-log difficulty under coordinate/basepoint change (rfc8032:521, :834).
quantum break: schemes whose security rests on DLP are vulnerable to sufficiently capable quantum computers (fips203:354, :358).
post-quantum standardization: NIST opened the PQC process in 2016 to replace discrete-log schemes (fips203:358).
